snippet.title: Ali Abdaal
snippet.description:
I'm Ali - doctor turned entrepreneur, YouTuber, and author of the New York Times bestseller Feel-Good Productivity. 

On this channel, we explore the skills that school didn't teach you - productivity, personal development, how to become financially free, how to build your own independent business. These are the skills I learned through trial-and-error while trying to build my own business alongside medical school at Cambridge University. After years of trying, learning and making mistakes, I ended up in a life I could never have imagined. On this YouTube channel, I try my best to share everything I've learned (and that I'm continuing to learn) along the way :) 

The channel's been active since 2017, when I first started vlogging my life as a medical student and sharing study tips. Since then, I graduated, became a doctor, worked full-time in the UK's NHS (including during COVID), started a business, grew it to 7-figures, wrote a book, got married and had a baby girl :)

snippet.title: Michael Ballard / slashdev
snippet.description:
If you want to learn about startups and software, then you are in the right place! My name is Michael, I am the founder of slashdev.io, a talent platform for connecting the best software engineers from around the world to companies in the USA and Europe. I have worked with technology and growth for over 10+ years building my skillset to build and sell as a founder. 

This channel is for venture builders, software engineers, and startup founders. My aim is to inspire you with powerful stories, empower you with practical tactics and strategies, and learn together in the process.

In this channel we will:

- Discover how to build startups 
- Learn new growth strategies and tactics
- Study the greatest entrepreneurs from history
- Learn to build scalable modern software applications 
- Study programming in ReactJS, NodeJS, iOS, Android, Flutter, Blockchain, & more.

snippet.title: Gayatri Agrawal
snippet.description:
I started this channel to help you upskill with AI tools and answer the burning questions you've always had about AI.

If you've ever wondered:
"How do I learn AI?"
"How do I make money using AI?"
"How do I land a job in AI?"

You're in the right place.

My story began in Kesinga, a small town about one-hundredth the size of Mumbai. Success, for me, meant building skyscrapers and transforming cities, so I became an architect. But soon I realized technology, especially AI, could impact millions of lives far more rapidly.

Eventually, India's untapped potential drew me back home, and that's when I founded ALTRD.

Having worked extensively with AI before it became mainstream, and training over 10,000 professionals in AI but I wanted to teach this to everyone so I created this channel to cut through the noise and help you make AI truly work for you.

Subscribe to learn, grow, and thrive in the world of AI.
